analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price ($20.72) vs SMA5 ($23.64)/SMA20 ($29.35)/SMA50 ($34.88): confirming below short- and mid-term trends
· Significant decline vs SMA100 ($37.49)/SMA200 ($40.91): indicating weakened long-term trend

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.3609 → -0.8209): continued weakness, worsening after a death cross
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near lower band $21.28): approaching the lower band
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($27.83): first resistance level on short-term bounces
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High): confirming continuation of downtrend
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): RSI entering oversold territory, maintaining a wait-and-see approach for rebound signals
